The '''AF-series''' (standing for Assault Fighter)<ref name="db">{{DB|starship|z95headhunter|Z-95 Headhunter}}</ref> was a series of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] produced by the [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]].<ref name="tst">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref> Known models of this series were the [[Z-95 AF-3 Headhunter]]<ref name="tst" /> and the [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunter]].<ref name="db" />
